annotations.title: Mastodon hashtag timeline, account, search or trends, live

description: Mastodon data, live and keyless (any public instance): a hashtag timeline, an account with its latest posts, account or hashtag search, or trending hashtags, each post with text, counts, media and tags. Use it for social listening and trend tracking in the fediverse. Input: mode (hashtag, account, search, trends) with tag, acct or query; optional instance, limit. $0.05 per call. Returns: mode, instance, tag, acct, query, kind, account{}, statuses[], accounts[], hashtags[], status_count, source, as_of, checked_at.

acct.description: Username, optionally @domain (Gargron or Gargron@mastodon.social); account mode.

kind.description: What to search for, default accounts.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

limit.description: Items to return (hashtag up to 40, search up to 25, trends up to 20), default 10.

mode.description: hashtag: latest statuses under a tag; account: an account and its statuses; search: accounts or hashtags matching a query; trends: trending hashtags.

statuses.description: Latest statuses to return in account mode, default 10.

name: hubvibe_social_mastodon
title: Mastodon hashtag timeline, account, search or trends, live
